prior_exposure: The author reviewed the retained table, prior cohort and baseline and coordinated with an agent that independently reread the same retained filing. This is an exposed collaborative review of one issuer document, not blind adjudication, independent publisher corroboration or independent physical verification.
rationale: The operating-table Fab(1) header directly references footnote (1), which explicitly assigns geographic labels to all sixteen rows. Admit these labels as source statements with unknown effective dates, not geometry or locations at historical commencement. Two subsidiary narratives explicitly identify their manufacturing fab and report the same commercial-production commencement event at month precision: Fab 11 in October 1998 and Fab 16 in April 2018. Retain these as additional same-document assertions, preserving the original year assertions and their clocks, not independent outcomes or extra facilities. The manufacture-entity descriptions establish within-document correspondence only; they do not merge a corporation with a facility or identify a unique project phase. All sixteen project-phase correspondences remain unresolved. This review admits no capacity, canonical identity, corporate aliases, physical-current facts, HVM equivalence, forecasts or scores. The population remains the original survivor-selected operating-fab table.
